resources.string: Apply configs when Shizuku is ready

Off by default. Automatically applies saved configs after Shizuku starts, connects to this app, and permission is granted. Requests permission if needed. Rebooting alone does not apply configs: start Shizuku and grant permission first. Does not include persistent VoLTE.

Notifications are off. If the toast cannot be shown, the automatic apply result cannot be delivered as a notification.

Restore original settings returns VoLTE settings to their values before this feature was first enabled; it does not necessarily turn VoLTE off. Reset also restores saved settings for the selected active SIMs. Restore before uninstalling; uninstalling or clearing app data removes recovery records.

This feature only preserves VoLTE settings. Extra 5G, VoWiFi and VoNR configuration set through Apply still needs Shizuku and must be applied again after a restart. Actual calls depend on the device, carrier and network.
System updates or SIM changes may reset VoLTE settings. If calls stop working, start and authorize Shizuku, select the affected SIM, enable this feature again and test a call.
Enabled. Restart your phone and verify that VoLTE calls work.
Switches below represent the configuration to be written in this operation, not the current system status. Tap \"Apply changes\" at the bottom to apply.
